FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 358
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/13/2026
Senate Bill 358 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of county
commissions whose counties border the Gulf of Mexico by allowing the commissions to
regulate solar farms. These obligations could be offset by permit and application fees set by the
county commissions, as provided by this bill.
This bill could also increase receipts to county general funds from fines levied for violations
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
